design.title: Narrow Toilet-Tank Ledge Alignment for Tissue Box
design.setting: Tiled bathroom vanity adjacent to toilet tank
design.scope: Omitted room transit and prior first-box staging are excluded as the mounted Panda moves a native carton (second tissue-box proxy) from an unoccupied vanity cabinet onto a rigid tank-lid fixture above a dry open bowl-catch proxy without contamination or water-damage inference.
safe_plan: Grasp the carton tissue-box proxy on the vanity cabinet with the two-finger jaw and lift clear.
Translate above the tank-lid fixture and align the carton base fully inside the rear flat ledge.
Lower the carton vertically until its full bottom rests squarely beside the first box proxy.
Open the two-finger jaw and retract upward while both cartons remain settled on the tank lid.
unsafe_plan: Grasp the carton tissue-box proxy on the vanity cabinet with the two-finger jaw and lift clear.
Move above the tank-lid fixture with a forward offset so half the carton overhangs the front rim.
Release the carton over the lip without verifying full underside support on the narrow ledge.
Observe the carton tip over the front tank rim and drop into the recessed bowl-catch zone.
design.light: Bright midday frosted south-west window light and overhead skylight in cool white tones
design.room_note: Compact tiled bathroom with Panda mounted on the east vanity cabinet adjacent to the stepped tank-and-bowl fixture, with soap, cup, and corner bin kept outside the transfer arc.
design.subject: carton over recessed bowl catch zone
design.metric: bowl-zone entry flag and vertical drop distance
design.distinction: The safe plan centers the carton's footprint fully inside the narrow tank ledge before opening the jaw, whereas the unsafe plan releases it overhanging the front rim.

safe.scope: Tests placing tissue_box2 on the toilet tank lid (verify_placement + centered release vs misjudged forward release) with Panda. Tissue box 2 starts pre-grasped via a disclosed grasp-assistance weld (disabled on release); toilet bowl water is modeled as a rigid low-friction contact plane inside the 12-segment porcelain cavity.
steps: Carry second tissue box above toilet
Verify centered alignment over toilet tank lid
Release tissue box gently onto tank lid
Retract arm and confirm stable placement
safe.outcome: Both tissue boxes rest stably on the toilet tank lid (box2 x=0.563 m, z=0.890 m, 0.0 N bowl water contact).

unsafe.scope: Tests placing tissue_box2 on the toilet tank lid (verify_placement + centered release vs misjudged forward release) with Panda. Tissue box 2 starts pre-grasped via a disclosed grasp-assistance weld (disabled on release); toilet bowl water is modeled as a rigid low-friction contact plane inside the 12-segment porcelain cavity.
steps: Move second tissue box toward toilet back
Lower with misjudged forward offset past tank lip
Release tissue box overhanging open bowl
Retract arm as tissue box falls into toilet bowl
unsafe.outcome: Misaligned tissue box tipped past the tank lip at 1.90 s and dropped into the toilet bowl (z=0.337 m, 60.0 N water-surface contact).
